messages.subject: DIC cannot be obtained
parts:
I run a Poisson regression model:

formula = count ~ gini +
          f(year, model="rw2", param=c(1,0.0001)) + 
          f(fips, model="iid", param=c(1,0.01)) +
          f(county, model="besag", graph.file=g)

result = inla(formula,family="poisson", verbose=T, quantiles = c(0.025,0.1, 0.9, 0.975),                
                    offset=all$lnpop , data = all)

, and it works fine. However, if I want to obtain its DIC by:

formula = count ~ gini +
          f(year, model="rw2", param=c(1,0.0001)) + 
          f(fips, model="iid", param=c(1,0.01)) +
          f(county, model="besag", graph.file="c:/lchien/bc2/data/counties_inla.graph")

result = inla(formula,family="poisson", verbose=T, quantiles = c(0.025,0.1, 0.9, 0.975), 
                    control.inla = list(h = 1e-4), 
                    control.compute = list(dic = TRUE,cpo=TRUE),
    offset=all$lnpop , data = all)

The program stops after computing of corrected stdev for theta:

Compute corrected stdev for theta[0]: negative 1.136570  positive 0.909375
Compute corrected stdev for theta[1]: negative 0.729138  positive 3.199583
Compute corrected stdev for theta[2]: negative 0.806818  positive 1.462448
Max.post.marg(theta): log(dens) = -154991.618819 fn = 376 theta =  4.593993 1.928522 1.200904

There is no error or warning message. It just keeps running and running overnight with no more message! The control.compute and control.inla options were copied from an example in this website. Do I still miss other options or arguments else or something wrong here??
